Apps.Name: Microsoft Store (Instalar/Reparar)
Apps.Description: Instala o restaura la tienda oficial Microsoft Store (wsreset -i)
Apps.Target: Write-Host '=== Instalando / Reparando Microsoft Store ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; wsreset -i; Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers Microsoft.WindowsStore | ForEach-Object { Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register ($_.InstallLocation + '\AppXManifest.xml') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Solicitud enviada a Windows. Microsoft Store aparecera en unos momentos.' -ForegroundColor Green; Read-Host 'Presiona Enter para cerrar'

Apps.Name: ReviOS (AME Wizard + Playbook)
Apps.Description: Descarga AME Wizard oficial, abre descarga del Playbook ReviOS y lo lanza
Apps.Target: $dir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Desktop\ReviOS_Setup'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null; $zip = Join-Path $dir 'AME_Wizard.zip'; Write-Host 'Descargando AME Wizard oficial...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Invoke-WebRequest 'https://download.ameliorated.io/AME%20Wizard%20Beta.zip' -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $dir -Force; Remove-Item $zip -Force; Write-Host 'Abriendo descarga oficial del Playbook ReviOS (revi.cc)...' -ForegroundColor Green; Start-Process 'https://revi.cc/revios/download'; $exe = Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Filter '*AME*.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($exe) { Start-Process $exe.FullName }; Write-Host ('Carpeta lista en: ' + $dir) -ForegroundColor Yellow; Read-Host 'Descarga el Playbook .apbx y arrastralo a AME Wizard. Presiona Enter para cerrar'

Apps.Target: Write-Host '=== Entradas de arranque actuales (BCDEdit) ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; bcdedit /enum all; $bak = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ('Desktop\BCD_Backup_' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')); bcdedit /export $bak; Write-Host ('Respaldo BCD guardado en: ' + $bak) -ForegroundColor Green; Read-Host 'Presiona Enter para cerrar'
